title: S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Indices (January 2027 data), 9:00 a.m. ET — the same-minute co-tenant of the FHFA HPI morning, on the quarter's penultimate session
source: NEWS: the publisher's own standing rule, read verbatim out of THREE separate S&P Dow Jones Indices press releases fetched direct 2026-09-08, not one: the June-2026-data edition (press.spglobal.com/2026-08-25-S-P-Cotality-Case-Shiller-Index-Reports-Annual-Gain-in-June-2026, HTTP 200, 90,693 bytes), the February-2026-data edition (2026-04-28 slug, HTTP 200, 98,223 bytes) and the January-2026-data edition (2026-04-28 slug, HTTP 200, 95,278 bytes). All three carry the identical sentence: "The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Indices are published on the last Tuesday of each month at 9:00 am ET." Independently reproduced by weekday arithmetic — March 2027's Tuesdays are the 2nd, 9th, 16th, 23rd and 30th, so 2027-03-30 is the last — and the stated two-month reporting lag (the 2026-08-25 edition reports June 2026) puts JANUARY 2027 data on it. Corroborated by the publisher's newsroom archive, keyword-filtered for Case-Shiller (press.spglobal.com/index.php?s=2429&mode=list&keywords=Case-Shiller, HTTP 200, 82,810 bytes unfiltered and 80,194 bytes for year=2026, same fetch): every 2026 Case-Shiller slug it lists falls on that month's last Tuesday — 2026-01-27, 2026-02-24, 2026-05-26, 2026-06-30, 2026-07-28, 2026-08-25 — with the single exception being TWO editions sharing the 2026-04-28 slug, which the initial research resolves (see notes). Filed estimate on taxonomy, NOT on date doubt: CONFIRMED_PREFIX in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs is (IR|CAL|BLS|FED|PJM|SEC|TSY|OCC|BEA|CENSUS|ISM|CB|UMICH|FHFA) and has no member for an index provider's own standing publication rule — the same gap every S&P DJI and Russell entry on this calendar records. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fhfa-hpi-2027-03-30 initial research (2026-09-08) as its same-minute, same-reference-month co-tenant; researched the same day, and the proposal file is now shadowed by this canonical one. WHAT THE INITIAL RESEARCH FOUND, AND IT CORRECTS THE PROPOSER: the fhfa-hpi-2027-03-30 ledger banked "the one verified FHFA-only 9:00 morning in the modern sample is a March release" on the observation that no Case-Shiller release exists in March 2026. IT DOES EXIST. The invariant is the publisher's own Detroit/Wayne County notice, which names that release's OWN release date, and it holds 3 of 3 in the documents fetched today: the June-data edition says "the August 25, 2026, release date" against an August 25 dateline; the February-data edition says "the April 28, 2026, release date" against an April 28 dateline; and the January-data edition says "the March 31, 2026, release date" against an APRIL 28 dateline. The sole mismatch is the January-data document, and its body is the primary while the dateline is the artifact -- 2026-03-31 is the last Tuesday of March 2026 by arithmetic, the once-a-month rule forbids the two editions the archive currently shows on 2026-04-28, and the 2026-03-31 press slug returns HTTP 404 (moved, not never-created). So the March slot was published on schedule, March mornings are NOT FHFA-only, and there is no clean single-publisher 9:00 morning anywhere in the modern sample. This resolves a question three sibling lanes have now handled three different ways (pending-home-sales-2026-10-20 read the archive as a cadence slip, case-shiller-hpi-2026-10-27 refuted it from ALFRED and the same body quote, fhfa-hpi-2027-03-30 built a finding on the slip) -- all three were reading one artifact, and only the release bodies settle it. PLACEMENT, ALL CALENDAR ARITHMETIC: 2027-03-30 is the PENULTIMATE session of Q1 2027 (T-1), and the last-Tuesday rule puts 22 of 22 quarter-ending-month editions since 2021 inside their quarter's final five sessions -- roughly a third of all editions are quarter-end editions by construction. It is also the ONLY March edition in 2021-2031 with a full US market closure inside its prior five sessions (good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, Easter 2027-03-28 by computus); Good Friday precedes the March last Tuesday in only 6 of the 51 years 1990-2040. CONTENT: January is the seasonal trough of the NSA calendar -- median m/m +0.054pp with 43.6% of Januaries negative (n=39) against May's +0.901pp and 5% -- so this edition's headline m/m carries less signal than any spring edition and the y/y is the only number in it.
